summary: Parkevtate Vosianc reviews Amazon after its quarterly print: group sales up 12%, but AWS is the story, accelerating to 39% growth from 37%, with AWS operating income jumping to $17.8B from $11.4B and group operating income to $28B from $17.4B. Operating cash flow rose 29% to $168B, which matters because Amazon is spending over $200B a year on capital expenditure and he wants it funded internally rather than by selling shares, as Alphabet and Meta have had to do. Management's suggestion that AWS grows at or above 40% in both 2027 and 2028 is his favourite detail. Against that, advertising growth decelerated from 26% to 12% on a difficult Prime Day comparison, capex is running above a $300B annualised pace with $48B of new debt in the quarter, and headcount growth is accelerating. Trading at $239 against a $325 DCF fair value, he reiterates BUY, keeps Amazon a top-10 buy, and will add opportunistically into year-end; the bull case is free cash flow inflecting from 2029 as data-centre capex peaks in 2028-29. Note: the caption file ends mid-sentence, but the call is stated in full earlier in the video.
